name: KorAm Bank

summary.text: KorAm Bank was a South Korean commercial bank in which a consortium led by the Carlyle Group, with JPMorgan's Corsair fund, acquired a controlling 40.5 percent stake in October 2000 in the aftermath of the Asian financial crisis. In February 2004 Citigroup agreed to buy the consortium's 36.6 percent holding and launch a tender offer for the remaining shares at KRW 15,500 each, a deal announced at KRW 3.18 trillion ($2.73 billion); on completion Citigroup held about 97.5 percent for about $2.6 billion, the first takeover of a Korean bank by a foreign commercial lender.
